title: Marc at Camp Lincoln Laurel, Summer Cabin - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckle-edge snapshot capturing a young boy named Marc standing outside a wooden cabin at Camp Lincoln Laurel during the summer of 1952. He rests his arm against a rustic log railing while smiling slightly toward the camera. He is dressed in typical mid-century camp attire, including a branded 'Camps Lincoln-Laurel' t-shirt, dark shorts, a baseball-style cap, white socks, and high-top canvas sneakers. The cabin behind him features propped-open awning windows and log underpinnings, epitomizing the classic post-WWII American summer camp experience.
